name: Effect Remover
author: automata-rtx
description: Cuts down or removes built-in Twilight Princess visual features so they don't fight new realtime graphical effects. Bundles three independently-toggleable removers, each targeting one of TP's fake-shading systems: Haze Removal (the drifting mist, dust, steam and glare drawn over the scene, suppressible per mode - the game's own code calls this system 'moya', Japanese for mist/haze, which is why the log and mode list use that word; note these are camera-facing haze cards, not shade projected onto the ground), Terrain Shadow Removal (the animated shadow overlay baked into terrain materials, per material code), and Unbaked Vertex Lighting (fades the lighting painted into geometry's vertex colors, 0 = flat, 100 = vanilla). Each has its own section in the settings and can be toggled or tuned on its own. EXPERIMENTAL
